definition.name: forgotten_event
definition.purpose: Finite-window averaging forgets an unresolved old event.

definition.name: recent_event
definition.purpose: Rolling equalization can repay part of a recent loss but optimize a different endpoint.

definition.name: zero_harm_allowance
definition.purpose: No compensation without slack or permitted donor loss on this frontier.

definition.name: no_recipient_headroom
definition.purpose: Inability to deliver excess does not erase outstanding event loss.

definition.name: shared_success_with_slack
definition.purpose: Both direct rolling rules and recovery can fully compensate; no exclusive advantage.

definition.name: future_opportunity_trap
definition.purpose: Myopic normalized recovery loses to a known-future oracle and debt-weighted control.

definition.name: donor_budget_trap
definition.purpose: Spending a scarce donor budget early makes greedy recovery worse than rolling Nash.

definition.name: opportunity_disappears
definition.purpose: Same first step and budget, but waiting now loses the only compensation opportunity.

definition.name: quality_ceiling
definition.purpose: A reference already at maximum quality cannot be compensated by more quality.

single_recipient.scope: one recipient, exogenous independent action sets, nonbinding total donor budget

multi_recipient.scope: constructed two-step, two-recipient opportunity family; not a probability distribution
